input.text: The cutoff for outgoing commercial wires is 2:00 PM Central time.
input.heading: Steps

input.text: Call the customer back at a phone number already on file before releasing any outgoing wire of $25,000 or more.
input.heading: Steps

input.text: For commercial accounts, call the customer back at a phone number already on file before releasing any outgoing wire of $25,000 or more.
input.heading: Steps

input.text: Post incoming wires the same day when they arrive by 4:30 PM Central.
input.heading: Steps

document.title: Wire Cutoffs on Holidays and Weekends

input.text: Incoming wires received by 4:30 PM Central are posted to the customer's account the same day.
input.heading: Steps

document.title: Wire Cutoffs on Holidays and Weekends

input.text: Outgoing consumer and small business wire requests received after 4:00 PM Central are processed the next business day.
input.heading: Steps

document.title: Wire Cutoffs on Holidays and Weekends

input.text: Only a wire specialist may complete the callback for an outgoing wire.
input.heading: Steps

document.title: Wire Cutoffs on Holidays and Weekends

input.text: Call the customer back at a phone number already on file before releasing any outgoing wire of $10,000 or more.
input.heading: Steps

input.text: Callbacks are completed by an operations employee, never by the employee who took the request.
input.heading: Steps

input.text: An operations manager must give a second approval for any outgoing wire above $50,000.
